wi_meader_wall.blurb: Meader Wall is a south-facing wall of bolted sport climbing on Grandad Bluff above La Crosse, one of the older and more established walls in the park. The cliff stands about 55 feet high and leans out around four feet on many lines, so the climbing is steep and powerful on generally big holds. Grades run from the low 5.10s into 5.13, with most routes in the 5.12 range, plus a top-rope line and a single boulder problem. It suits climbers comfortable on hard, overhanging sport routes rather than beginners.

wi_granite_path.blurb: Granite Path is a small bouldering spot in Governor Thompson State Park in northeast Wisconsin, where an outcrop beside the Granite Path trail holds around eleven problems. Many of them are highballs, so bring plenty of pads and spotters. The range is wide, from an easy V0 jug haul through mid-grade problems in the V3 to V5 range to a few much harder lines up to V8. It is a quiet, woodsy setting best suited to confident boulderers who are happy topping out tall problems.

wi_bunker_the.blurb: The Bunker is a compact boulder field at Devil's Lake, sitting below the East Bluff trail north of the Balanced Rock junction. It holds about eleven problems with a very broad spread: a V0 warm-up, a few V2 to V4 lines, and a run of serious testpieces from V5 up toward V9. It is small, so it works best as a stop on a wider East Bluff bouldering day, tied in with the nearby Horse Rampart Talus fields, rather than a destination on its own.

wi_10_above_anthrax.blurb: Above Anthrax is a small, scattered sector at the north end of Petenwell Rock near Necedah, on the sandstone towers of central Wisconsin. Its eleven climbs are mostly bolted sport lines with a few trad routes and one boulder problem. Grades start around 5.6 and run through the 5.10s up to 5.13, so there is a little something for climbers at either end. The main block faces the river, and the sandstone should be dry before you climb it. Petenwell is a quieter alternative to Devil's Lake.

wi_2_reclining_tower.blurb: Reclining Tower is a small formation on the West Bluff at Devil's Lake State Park, close to the upper end of the Prospect Point Rampart. Its eleven routes are mostly trad with a few top-rope lines, running from easy fourth-class and low 5th-class climbs through 5.6 and 5.7 to a handful of hard 5.10 to 5.12 pitches. It is a good place for a full day of moderate to demanding climbing, and it sees very little traffic compared with the busier walls around the lake, so you will often have it to yourself.

wi_jenga.blurb: Jenga is a tumbled stack of blocks in the West Bluff Central bouldering zone at Devil's Lake, just below Reclining Tower and reached either through the big boulder fields below or from above the Slant boulder field. About eleven problems range from an easy V0 and moderate V4 to V5 lines up through powerful V8 to V11 testpieces. The namesake V6 is a well-loved classic. It rewards stronger boulderers, though a few friendlier problems sit alongside the hard ones.
